scope: PM July image trials and revisions recovered from retained Git history after their authoring files were removed from current working trees. This supplements, and overlaps, the other image registers.
verification: Explicit per-material font fields and collection indices establish use. A configured or excluded font list alone does not establish image use. Recorded hashes are checked against retained Git images in their actual domain: PNG bytes or decoded RGBA pixels. Outputs without historical hashes have a separately labelled observed retained hash, not a claimed historical hash match.
license_correction: Historical BIZ open_license labels were incorrect for the Microsoft-supplied TTCs actually used. They are corrected to Windows font licensing here; the separate OFL distribution is not substituted retrospectively.

inheritance.verification: The retained saturated composer directly opens this precomposed neutral text layer and its composite instead of rendering a new font. The later whiteproof record explicitly attributes the source to Regular TTC face 1; its white glyph mask is independently reproduced by the retained face-1 renderer. The saturated output itself is not retained, so no output identity is claimed.
